findings.rootCause: The long authenticated proof was fail-fast and external prerequisites were not aggregated before browser execution. Each run therefore stopped at the first independent missing precondition (route host, edit-state transition, prompt binding, isolated credential vault, Secret Manager IAM/package), making already-preserved product fixes appear as repeated interruption.
findings.remediation: Preserve fail-closed writes, but aggregate independent access/IAM/package prerequisites before the browser proof, classify failures as PRODUCT/HARNESS/INFRASTRUCTURE/DATA, preserve prior PASS evidence unless causally invalidated, and never make a product-source change for a harness-only failure.
findings.closureProof: Run 36162989052 completed authenticated B2 PASS; workflow now aggregates independent access/IAM/package prerequisites before future long browser proof.

findings.rootCause: After removing the production-vault cross-read, the exact Preview callable still returns functions/unavailable from readVaultScope(preview). This proves the isolated preview vault itself is not usable by the runtime identity; the remaining causal surface is preview-secret existence/IAM, not Aseguradoras UI, active role, prompt binding or operational Firestore.
findings.remediation: Idempotently ensure only the Preview secret exists and bind the runtime service account to secret-level viewer, secretAccessor and secretVersionAdder. Never read payload, never touch production secret. Then rerun the exact authenticated proof.
findings.closureProof: IAM proof PASS + exact Preview credential import mapping + insurer metadata readback + password reveal hash-match + preview cleanup + LIVE untouched.

findings.rootCause: readEffectiveVault(preview) merged production+preview, and preview import used production as fallback base. The isolated Preview callable therefore required production Secret Manager read access, contradicting isolation and causing functions/unavailable before any insurer metadata write.
findings.remediation: Preview scope reads/writes preview vault only; production scope remains production-only. Exact authenticated proof must save logo+password, receive cred_* mapping, reveal hash-match from preview vault, cleanup preview secret record, and leave LIVE untouched.
findings.closureProof: New immutable B2 Preview: credential import PASS, insurer durable update PASS, logo reload PASS, reveal hash-match PASS, preview cleanup PASS, LIVE untouched.

findings.rootCause: The harness waited for global [data-in].last() and clicked global [data-yes].last(). The product uses overlay-scoped prompts; unrelated/stale overlays can make the proof close a different dialog while guardarDraft remains awaiting its own U.prompt.
findings.remediation: Bind the reason input and confirmation button to the same visible .drawer-back containing [data-in], capture its title/value, click its own [data-yes], and require that exact overlay to detach before evaluating persistence.
findings.closureProof: Exact fe140 Preview reaches secure provider/batch writer or yields a product-specific save failure after the correctly-bound prompt; no ambiguous global dialog interaction.

findings.rootCause: render(host) always processed route.params.ficha by calling ficha(deepId) with default view semantics. Any module rerender while editing therefore replaced the active draft with read-only state even after the async knowledge refresh path was fixed.
findings.remediation: When render(host) reopens the deep-linked insurer already in editing state, call ficha(deepId, undefined, true) so edit/draft/credentialDrafts survive; normal deep-link opens remain view-only.
findings.closureProof: New exact Preview stays in edit mode through full module rerender, saves logo and password, and completes canonical + secure readback.

findings.rootCause: ensureKnowledgeSummaryLoaded() invokes refreshOwnerView() on script.onload; refreshOwnerView() called ficha(id) without edit-state preservation. ficha() interpreted missing startEdit as false, discarding editing/draft/credentialDrafts.
findings.remediation: Async owner refresh calls ficha(id, undefined, true); ficha preserves existing editing flag, draft, credentialDrafts, snapshot and saving only for this internal refresh path. Normal open/edit/cancel/save semantics remain explicit.
findings.closureProof: New exact Preview remains in edit mode after deferred knowledge load; logo + password can be entered and saved; canonical insurer readback and secure credential reveal/cleanup PASS.

findings.rootCause: Router transition is asynchronous. Waiting for generic #host .page can match the stale Cliente360 page; Aseguradoras ficha() then runs before Aseguradoras.render(host) has assigned its module-scoped host.

findings.closureProof: Exact same Preview completes insurer logo/credential proof and all later renewal/cleanup assertions.

findings.requiredProof: Same exact Preview authenticated run ends with clientAbsent=true, insurerAbsent=true, preview credential removed, assetPrefixResidual=0 and assetAbsent=true.

findings.finding: Same apparent vehicle remains rendered as multiple equivalent top-level cards/candidates when historical rows have incomplete plate identity; explicit physical history is not presented as one resolved identity plus subordinate history.
findings.rootCause: Current grouping uses plate as primary key and falls back to vehicle.id when plate is missing. Explicit versionOfVehicleId lineage is not used to collapse versioned relations, and incomplete-identity historical rows remain top-level cards.
findings.remediation: Group only by explicit physical lineage first (versionOfVehicleId/source relation), then exact plate. Keep ambiguous incomplete rows unmerged but move them to a clearly labeled historical/incomplete-identity section with physical IDs and policy context.
findings.requiredProof: Oscar vehicle view shows resolved current identity once; versioned records under history; ambiguous incomplete rows clearly separated; zero merge/delete writes.

findings.finding: Opening policy from vehicle resolves the physical policy ID but drops originating vehicle context and can show a same-number policy version without receipts, making it appear to be a different policy.
findings.rootCause: Vehicle page link passes only clientId+policyId; policy renderer selects first vehicle by policy and does not disclose same-number sibling physical versions or source vehicle context.
findings.remediation: Carry vehicleId into policy route, prefer exact linked vehicle, expose physical version context/vigency/ID, and explicitly disclose when this physical version has no receipt calendar while sibling same-number versions exist.
findings.requiredProof: Open from exact vehicle preserves vehicleId context and same physical policy ID; receipt section corresponds to that exact version; sibling versions are distinguishable.

findings.finding: Receipt detail exposes only Editar plan de recibos; there is no controlled edit for one specific receipt.
findings.rootCause: Native receipt detail delegates all changes to policy-level plan editing and has no per-receipt durable write contract.
findings.remediation: Add controlled per-receipt edit with reason, explicit allowed fields and durable readback; paid/conciliated receipts remain protected from destructive financial edits.
findings.requiredProof: Authorized role can edit one eligible receipt and reload same receipt; sibling receipts unchanged; paid evidence protected; portfolio row stays synchronized.

findings.finding: Recibos y pagos shows Pago reportado · por conciliar while Cobros can still appear empty, so existing payment evidence disappears when switching modules.
findings.rootCause: modules/cobros.js contained the reported-payment projection, but later-loaded cobros-cartera-i65-closure-bridge.js replaced mod.render and omitted it. The effective owner dropped payment evidence even after the browser read model reached estadoOperativo=pago_reportado.
findings.remediation: Project reported-payment evidence in the effective closure owner, keep it separate from canonical cobros, and preserve zero fabricated confirmed cobros.
findings.requiredProof: Same client shows reported-payment evidence in Cobros; zero fabricated confirmed cobros; validation/apply actions remain explicit.

findings.finding: Paula cannot persist a logo edit on a real insurer in Preview; UI correctly displays that real insurer persistence is protected.
findings.rootCause: B2 Preview write boundary is synthetic-only by design.
findings.remediation: Do not relax real-data protection. Treat automated synthetic insurer save/readback as the persistence proof and keep real-insurer visual review read-only.
findings.requiredProof: Synthetic insurer logo save/readback PASS remains bound to exact Preview; real insurer edit continues blocked in Preview; LIVE not touched.

findings.finding: Password reset/invitation controls exist in source, but end-to-end mailbox delivery remains unconfirmed; Fernando previously did not receive the email.
findings.rootCause: Firebase Auth request acceptance was implemented, but mailbox delivery was explicitly deferred in B1 and never proven in B2 authenticated proof.
findings.remediation: Keep temporary-password server reset as available functionality; retain resend-reset/invitation email as request-accepted-only until actual delivery is proven. Do not mark delivery resolved.
findings.requiredProof: Controlled non-production mailbox receives invitation/reset link and completes flow, or transactional email owner/configuration provides explicit delivery receipt.

findings.title: Active vehicle tied to current policy is projected as incomplete history while detail has canonical plate/policy/vigency.
findings.invariant: Any vehicle linked to a current policy is current; historical/versioned rows subordinate to the same canonical identity; ambiguous rows remain pending review, never heuristically merged/deleted.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: Vehicle tab may group on raw record while detail uses normalized vehicleVisual/canonical projection.

findings.title: A physical policy version visibly has two concurrent active receipt calendars after payment-plan edit.
findings.invariant: One physical policy version has exactly one active contractual calendar; superseded rows do not count in current schedule/active portfolio; paid/evidenced receipts are preserved with traceability.

findings.title: Current policy can render below renewed/historical policies.
findings.invariant: Order groups: current, renewal-due, renewed/history, cancelled/void; newest vigency first; same-number versions show current first with history subordinate.

findings.title: Operational UI exposes physical IDs/version/lineage language.
findings.invariant: Operational UI uses business language; physical IDs and lineage remain only in audit/technical detail when needed.

findings.title: Section titles/labels remain visually weak while values dominate.
findings.invariant: Section titles semibold/bold; relevant labels semibold; values regular/medium; total/KPI may stand out; apply cumulatively to Cliente360/Policy/Vehicle/Receipt.

findings.title: Human logo persistence cannot be verified safely against a real insurer in Preview.
findings.invariant: Provide visible synthetic insurer fixture for edit/upload/save/refresh/readback/cleanup without relaxing Preview boundary for real insurers.

findings.title: Sidebar vertical scroll/navigation defect must remain tracked and be fixed now if it blocks module access.
findings.invariant: Sidebar scroll is visible and usable; if non-blocking in B2 it is mandatory carry-forward to B4.

findings.title: An authorized applied/confirmed payment is a confirmed cobro even before reconciliation.
findings.invariant: Do not hide applied payments from Cobros; receipt existence alone never creates cobro.

findings.title: Inferred payment must not inflate the discovery/reconciliation month.
findings.invariant: For inferred payment, effective/display payment date belongs to the required contractual period and is explicitly marked inferred; evidenceAsOf and reconciliation/application dates remain distinct.

findings.title: Payment date, reconciliation date, insurer application date, invoice date are separate fields.
Existing reported payments require deterministic classification before projection as confirmed cobros.
findings.invariant: Do not auto-convert every pago_reportado and do not reimport.

findings.title: Issuance expenses/surcharges need insurer + product/line + payment-frequency configuration with policy override.
findings.invariant: No insurer hardcodes; preview resulting calendar before save.

findings.title: Dashboard must reconcile real portfolio, confirmed cobros, pending payments, reconciliation, currency/country and aging.
Renewal flow has competing legacy and operational owners and must be consolidated into one canonical end-to-end owner.
findings.invariant: Current policy -> renewal management -> risk/conditions -> quotes -> comparison -> client decision -> new vigency -> receipts/portfolio -> bidirectional history -> Ops/Leads/Cliente360 sync.

findings.title: Portal/importer/email surfaces must converge on the canonical financial and management model.
Preview is materially slow and can freeze the browser during client/receipt navigation.
findings.rootCause: Global projection/index invalidation and repeated full-collection scans remain in navigation/store event paths; runtime profiling still required to isolate dominant cost.

findings.title: Cliente 360 KPI composition changes visibly during hydration.
findings.rootCause: crm-v1198-operational-bridge enhanceClientList() runs after Cliente360 render and recalculates KPI footer from scoped raw clientes. Product read-only store keeps raw tipo values, while Cliente360's canonical projection normalizes them to Persona/Empresa. The after-hook overwrote the correct canonical footer with 0/0.

findings.title: Policy detail bypasses canonical current-calendar receipt projection and renders duplicated requirements.
findings.rootCause: receiptRows() reads raw receipt collection whereas receiptSchedule()/client receipt tab use canonical projection.

findings.title: Receipt filter lists renewed/historical policies instead of only current policies.
findings.rootCause: renderReceipts() builds options from every client policy with no activePolicy predicate.

findings.title: Cobros surface counts reported payments but does not render them as visible evidence rows.
findings.rootCause: tabCobros() renders only cobros; patchCobros() injects an informational count but no reported-payment rows.

findings.title: Same normalized plate/policy can appear as multiple vehicle cards.
findings.rootCause: Vehicle grouping prioritizes lineage root over normalized plate; distinct lineage roots are not reconciled by plate identity.

findings.title: Policy payment section hierarchy remains visually insufficient in human review.
findings.rootCause: Section heading styling improved, but business hierarchy/scanability of payment data did not meet visual acceptance.
